metric.purpose: One number per stat cell (Today pipeline strip, Product overview); tabular. Never a heading.

body.purpose: Default for cells, buttons, nav, descriptions; 500 for primary-column names and button labels.

table-header.purpose: Column headers, SubHeading, board column titles.

label.purpose: Status labels, meta line, tooltips, filter chips, segmented items, secondary tokens.

caption.purpose: Nav group labels, count pills, badges, avatar initials, kbd hints.

shadows.name: ring
shadows.purpose: Every resting surface: table container, secondary buttons, filter chips, board cards, callouts, active nav item, selected segmented item, global search entry.

shadows.name: control

shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: Popovers, menus, toasts, command palette, hover-expanded sidebar.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Buttons, nav, tabs, segmented items, toggles, board cards, rail width.

motion.name: intent-delay
motion.purpose: Rail expand, tooltip open, skeleton appearance.

components.name: Button

narrative.overview:
Fortify reads like a calm infrastructure console that happens to run an insurance agency. The grammar is the Cloudflare dashboard's (neutral canvas, white working surfaces, hairline rings, one blue, dense 40px tables) with none of Cloudflare's brand: no orange, no cloud, no borrowed name. Neutrals carry nearly the whole interface; color appears only where it means something: the one action blue, and status hues that encode state.

Density is a feature. A Producer or Account Manager should scan forty Accounts and know what is due next without opening one, so rows stay at 40px, numbers sit in tabular figures, and nothing is padded to look airy. The one expressive move is the Term ribbon, a 12-month micro-timeline drawn from data in every row; everything around it stays quiet so it can be read.

The rejected category default is the card grid with colored stage pills and an oversized KPI hero. Light mode only; WCAG 2.2 AA is a floor, and the contrast-corrected tokens below are part of the system, not exceptions to it.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral canvas, white surfaces, 1px ring edges instead of borders.
One accent: action blue, which is also the brand hue.
Inter Variable throughout, 14px base, -0.16px tracking, weights 400/500/600 only.
Status as dot plus label; pills only for counts and plan-like badges.
One urgency rule for every date, and one toolbar for every list.
The Term ribbon as the signature data glyph.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Action Blue is the only accent. It appears on the primary action, focus, links, selection, progress lines, unread dots, the first chart series, ribbon ticks and the logomark; nowhere else. Active tabs and active nav use strong neutrals, not blue.

rules.name: The State-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Status hues appear only where they encode state (pipeline stage, policy status, renewal risk, urgency) and always beside a text label or icon. Status text tokens carry words and icons; status tints are Callout backgrounds only, with ink text on top.

rules.name: The Urgency Rule
rules.body: One rule for every date, deadline and SLA counter (dueTone, rendered by Due): past due or breached is Danger Text at 500; due today or inside its window (30 days unless the domain sets one, such as the X-date quote window) is Warning Text at 500; both carry a 14px clock. Nothing else gets an urgency color.

rules.name: The Three Weights Rule
rules.body: 400, 500 and 600 only. Nothing light, nothing bold beyond 600.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Counts, money, dates, rate changes and the meta line use tabular figures; numeric columns align right.

rules.name: The One Toolbar Rule
rules.body: Every list uses the same toolbar row (ListToolbar, built into DataTable): search (320px), Filters (a popover of URL-bound selects with a count pill), view controls (Segmented), Display, Export; a flexible gap; then secondary actions and the one primary action at the far right. All 36px. Filters never sit inline as bare selects; create actions live in the toolbar, not the page header.

rules.name: The No-Airy-Table Rule
rules.body: Rows are 40px, header row 40px. Never pad a table to look spacious.

rules.name: The Ring Not Border Rule
rules.body: Surfaces get edges from a ring shadow, never a CSS border. 1px `line` borders are reserved for structural shell dividers (top bar bottom, sidebar edge, tab strip, sidebar footer), and `fill` borders for table row dividers.

rules.name: The Two-Edge Rule
rules.body: Cards and tables keep the 0.1 hairline; only form controls get the 0.45 control line.

rules.name: The Premium Change Rule
rules.body: A premium change (RateChange) is a signed tabular percent: +10% or more is Danger Text, −5% or less is Success Text, anything between is ink. No arrows.

rules.name: The One Glyph Rule
rules.body: The ribbon is the only expressive element on a list surface. It stays a data glyph: no labels inside it, no color outside blue, warning and neutrals.

dos: Do use Action Blue only for the primary action, focus, links, selection, ribbon ticks and the logomark.
Do give surfaces a 1px ring at 0.1 alpha, and form controls the 0.45 control line.
Do keep rows at 40px and controls at 36px with an 8px radius; 12px only for the global search entry and large panels.
Do show status as a dot plus a 13px label, and keep pills for counts and plan-like badges.
Do build list pages from PageTitle, ViewTabs and DataTable (toolbar, filters, actions, meta), and messages from Callout; never hand-roll them.
Do use tabular figures and right alignment for numbers, and a muted "—" for empty cells.
Do keep rows in place on refetch with the 2px progress line; show skeletons only on first load after 150ms.
Do carry Office as a "Contact · Office" token for agency-scope roles rather than adding a column.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent, an orange brand color, or Cloudflare's name or mark.
Don't use filled colored pills for stage or policy status.
Don't put CSS borders on cards, tables, controls or popovers; borders are for shell dividers and row dividers only.
Don't use gradients, glass, or shadows outside the Ring, Control and Pop recipes.
Don't use weights other than 400, 500 and 600, or a second display face.
Don't pad tables to look airy, or add entrance animations.
Don't use arbitrary radii, font sizes, line heights or tracking (rounded-[5px], text-[10px]); stay on the scales above.
Don't lift a resting card with the Pop shadow on hover; hover fills Well Grey.
